d: Guy Fieri heads to Louisville, Kentucky, to visit The North End Cafe, a neighborhood favorite serving creative, scratch-made American comfort food. Owner Chris Johnson takes Guy inside a bustling kitchen where everything from sausage gravy and smoked meats to Mexican-inspired sauces is prepared from scratch. Guy samples the indulgent Hot Brown Omelet, flavorful huevos rancheros, and bourbon-glazed pork chops, discovering how this local cafe brings fresh ideas to classic dishes.
